description: Mobile banking social media and concentrated deposits accelerate liquidity flight.
Opaque private credit valuations and refinancing pressure transmit stress outside banks.
Insurance becomes unavailable or unaffordable in climate-exposed regions.
Debt service pressure and income insecurity raise defaults and reduce demand.
Higher borrowing costs and debt rollover pressure reduce public investment capacity.
Asset price collapse weakens collateral and triggers forced selling.
Weak standards direct capital toward symbolic green claims rather than real transition.
Operational cyber or settlement failure disrupts payment continuity and confidence.
